bio: At this restaurant with an appealing, clean-lined design, the food revolves around regional produce and seasonal ingredients. Highlights on the evening menu include veal bolognese and chateaubriand for two. The lunch menu is somewhat more limited. The regional wine list also features a selection from Weingut Rosenberger, a winery complete with guest house that is also located here. In summer, you can dine outdoors. Tip: Breakfast is also available.
